name: Unity Health Bar
goalName: Make a health bar, using MVC structure, supporting multiple resolutions
goal: Many games use a health bar, so I will be making one to practise. The MVC structure allows for easy navigation and seperation of code. As there exist multiple platforms / displays, the project has to support multiple resolutions.

approach.text:

result: As seen in the video below, the UI is shown correctly for all resolutions. The health bar behaves as expected, with the health not becoming less than 0 or higher than the maximum health.<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/R0zUboJ9xQ4>>
validation: I asked feedback from fellow peers, writing down their suggestions, and implementing them in the next version.
contribution: Now that I have a clearer understanding of UI components, I can make one for the Game Pie project. I will talk to my groupmates about menu's and level selecting (if we implement it due to time constraints).
